title: Input-copying machine
statement: For a symbol alphabet, a number $k$ of work tapes, and a selected tape $i<k$, define a machine with sweep, rewind, and done phases, initially in the sweep phase. During the sweep it copies each input symbol onto tape $i$ while moving that tape's head right; when it reaches the blank after the input, it moves that head left and begins rewinding, moving left across the stored symbols. At the blank before the input it moves the head right and enters the done phase, where it stays in that phase.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
